metadata.description: The Berner Bros is a fun filled fury adventure story about two Bernese Mountain Dog brothers named, Huck and Barley.  This story is based on my dog and my family’s best friend’s dog.  Bernese Mountain dogs were historically bred in Bern, Switzerland as working dogs to do tasks around the farm such as pulling milk carts.  In this story the pups go back to the Swiss Alps, and get into some trouble.  Go on this amazing adventure with me and the Berner Bros. We will have the most paw-some time!
